# Vendored libraries

## v78.1.0 math typography
KaTeX 0.16.47 JavaScript and CSS remain local. CSS font URLs point to the same version in the upstream jsDelivr distribution; font binaries are not bundled. Primary application UI uses system fonts. This legacy typography dependency is not a computation dependency and requires network access for its first use. See https://katex.org/docs/browser.html for the distribution layout.
